answer: Sealed-history challenge: each identity must solve a per-epoch challenge derived from its own prior signed outputs, hashed through a rotating cipher seeded by the epoch. A clone starting fresh has no valid history, so it must buy or farm a seed lineage, and the fresh seed lands in a sparse karst of unused keys where the challenge is hardest. Registration costs the attacker one full epoch of genuine signed activity per identity plus the small delta of compute to replay it.
